text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next up is core exercises.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We can go ahead and increase the
weight from
yesterday. I want to be able
to endure the
windblasts of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is not only brimming
with
motivation, she seems quite bubbly
as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose so. A pleasant easterly blew
by
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
now for the first set... I'll run like
that gale!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Could she be training by herself? I do
hope she's
not pushing herself too hard
again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The rushing wind... remains
distant...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll have to push harder next time.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I can see you have spirit. But if you push
yourself too hard, you'll wind up hurting
your legs again...
Just remember to pace
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I understand. But my legs... are fine.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear, but—oh? You're
right. Your leg muscles are much more
balanced than they
were last time I saw
you.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
And you kept your core very stable
during that
last run. Have you been
doing some special
training?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nothing in particular. I've just been
diligent with
the fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My trainer said that doing so would help
me ride
out even the most turbulent
winds without
faltering.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
You don't say... Hehe. Well, I'm glad you
found
yourself a good trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So am I. I'm very grateful for the roseate
current
that led us to each other.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I hope the benison breeze continues to
blow
about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr looks straight at me. I
feel inspired to keep supporting her as
she strengthens her body to withstand
gale-force
running.
